preparationsteps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water according to the package instructions.
In a pan, sauté garlic and pancetta in olive oil until crispy.
Whisk eggs and grated parmesan together in a bowl.
Drain pasta and toss it into the pancetta mixture.
Quickly add the egg mixture to the pasta and stir until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately with extra cheese.
recipes.additional: For an extra creamy texture, add a little bit of pasta water while mixing the eggs and cheese.

preparationsteps: Cook the fettuccine in salted water until al dente.
Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then pan-fry in olive oil until golden.
In a separate pan, sauté garlic and add heavy cream.
Add parmesan cheese to the cream mixture and stir until smooth.
Slice the cooked chicken and mix it with the fettuccine and cream sauce.
Serve hot with extra parmesan cheese on top.
recipes.additional: Garnish with fresh parsley for a burst of color and freshness.
